# mwtl full coding-agent context

This compact context complements `llms.txt`. Source files and public headers are
authoritative when a signature differs.

## Choose and initialize

mwtl is a thin native Windows UI library, not a cross-platform toolkit or custom
renderer. Start with `templates/basic-app`. Derive a final class from
`mwtl::WindowBase`, override `BuildUI()`, keep controls as members, create them
with `mwtl::ControlHost`, install `Row`/`Column`/`Overlay` layout, and enter with
`mwtl::RunApplication` from `wWinMain`.

## Events

Override typed window events. For commands use `event.IsClicked(control)` or
`event.Is(control, notification)`. Return `EventResult::Handled()` after
consuming an event; otherwise return `EventResult::Propagate()`.

## Ownership and threads

Control wrappers own their child HWND while valid. ControlHost allocates IDs and
creates controls but does not own wrapper objects. Retained layout references
native windows. All UI use stays on the creating thread. Workers copy a
`WindowWakeup`, call `TryWake`, and let `OnWakeup` update UI. A false wake during
shutdown is expected. Never capture locals into long-lived asynchronous work.

`SelectionAdapter<Control, Value>` owns typed ComboBox/ListBox/ComboBoxEx
values separately from native labels. It rejects invalid indices, is
UI-thread-only, and requires exclusive item mutation; never store application
object pointers in native item data.

## Layout

Use `_dip` literals. `Auto` measures content, `Fixed` reserves a DIP length, and
`Stretch` shares remaining space by weight and constraints. Use raw pixels only
at explicit Win32 boundaries.

## Common tasks

- Form and validation: `examples/form_binding`, `ValueBinding::Pull/Push`.
- Commands: `examples/notepad`, one CommandSet owns text/enabled/checked/visible/image/shortcut/action state for menu, toolbar, and accelerators. Toolbar image lists are borrowed; rebuild a menu to reinsert a hidden command.
- Tooltips and image lists: `ImageList` owns its HIMAGELIST while toolbars borrow
  it. `Tooltip` owns its popup but borrows owner/tool HWNDs and owns copied
  text; tooltip text never replaces a visible label or accessible name.
- Context menus: create an owned popup `Menu`, append the same `Command` objects
  used elsewhere, call `TrackResult`, and distinguish selected, cancelled, and
  failed results before posting `WM_COMMAND`.
- Tab workspace state: `mwtl/tab_workspace.h` owns stable nonzero `TabId`
  ordering, selection, title, dirty, and closable metadata but never documents
  or HWNDs. `TabControl::Synchronize` projects it into native items;
  `GetSelectedTabId` reads the real native selection.
- Tree/List data: use stable nonzero `TreeItemId` and `ListItemId`, never object
  pointers in native item data. ListView is multi-select by default. For large
  data create with `.virtual_data = true`, attach a shared `VirtualListModel`,
  route `WM_NOTIFY` through `HandleNotification`, check
  `TakeVirtualException`, and mutate through `UpdateVirtualModel` (preserves
  selected IDs) or use `RefreshVirtualModel` for a simple refresh.
- Split panes: `mwtl/splitter.h`; create `Splitter`, create both pane HWNDs as
  direct children of its HWND, then call `AttachPanes`. The splitter owns only
  its container and borrows pane identities. Geometry and constraints are DIPs;
  arrows and Home/End move the focused bar and `WM_NOTIFY` reports changes.
  Child-pane notifications, control commands, and context menus forward to the
  splitter parent. Use the complete composition in `examples/explorer` and
  `docs/tutorials/explorer-application.md`.
- Property pages: `mwtl/property_sheet.h`; give every page a stable nonzero ID,
  create controls in `initialize`, route edit/click notifications through
  `command`, call `SetDirty`, validate before mutating the model, commit in
  `apply`, and restore in `reset`. Modeless sheets are move-only UI-thread HWND
  owners. The canonical Settings application persists a candidate before
  replacing committed state and returns false on save failure so dirty state is
  retained. Follow `docs/tutorials/settings-application.md`,
  `docs/recipes/property-page.md`, and `examples/property_sheet`.
- Task dialogs: use structured `TaskDialogOptions` for custom/common buttons,
  radios, verification, progress, links, and callbacks. The controller is valid
  only during its UI-thread callback. Return `keep_open` to reject a button
  close; inspect HRESULT and `callback_exception` in `TaskDialogResult`.
- Custom dialogs: use move-only `Dialog` with borrowed owner, create child
  controls in `initialize`, and attach the ordinary retained layout with
  `SetLayout`. Modal calls use the native nested loop; modeless calls own their
  HWND. Inspect accepted/cancelled/failed status and captured callback errors.
- Tray utilities: use move-only `TrayIcon` with a stable GUID, borrowed owner
  and HICON, and an `WM_APP` callback. In `OnMessage`, recreate after
  `TaskbarCreated` or decode the v4 typed event. Keep mutations and destruction
  on the creating UI thread; build context commands from `CommandSet`.
  `TrayIconStateModel` provides the same add/recovery/detach transitions without
  HWNDs for deterministic unit tests.
- Document state: `mwtl/document.h`; contents and I/O remain application-owned,
  and transitions distinguish proceed, save-required, and cancelled outcomes.
- Unicode text files: `mwtl/text_file.h`; preserve detected UTF-8/UTF-16
  encoding, pass the read `FileStamp` when saving, and handle `changed`
  separately from ordinary I/O failure.
- Editor search: `mwtl/text_search.h`; use the pure helpers for deterministic
  forward/backward, case, whole-word, and replace-all behavior.
- Editor history: `mwtl/text_history.h`; use bounded snapshot history when an
  application needs deterministic Undo/Redo and saved-state tracking.
- Recent files: `mwtl/recent_files.h`; use the versioned registry helpers and
  handle missing, access-denied, and invalid-data states separately.
- Single instance: `mwtl/single_instance.h`; the primary registers its HWND and
  decodes activation, while a secondary forwards a bounded path with a timeout.
- Complete SDI editor: `examples/notepad` and `docs/tutorials/notepad.md`; its
  GUI test covers safe transitions, persistence, accessibility, DPI, repeated
  document cycles, and packaging. Use
  `docs/recipes/notepad-command-setting.md` for a compiled command-setting task.
- Direct2D is optional: request `COMPONENTS d2d`, link `mwtl::d2d`, and include
  `<mwtl/d2d_host.h>`. `D2DHost` owns BeginDraw/EndDraw and target recovery;
  callbacks receive borrowed views, coordinates are DIPs, and application data
  stays GPU-independent. Use `examples/drawing` and
  `docs/recipes/direct2d-drawing.md`. There is no `mwtl::Spacer` API.
- Direct3D is optional: request `COMPONENTS d3d`, link `mwtl::d3d`, and include
  `<mwtl/d3d_host.h>`. `RenderFrame` is on-demand and returns presented,
  minimized, occluded, recreated, or failed. GPU interfaces are borrowed;
  application data is device-independent and WARP fallback is explicit. See
  `docs/recipes/direct3d-swap-chain.md`.
- WIC imaging is optional: request `COMPONENTS imaging d2d`, initialize COM,
  keep bounded `DecodedImage` CPU pixels authoritative, and use
  `ImageViewportModel` for pixel-to-DIP Fit/zoom/pan. Embedded profile presence
  and successful sRGB conversion differ. Recreate only the D2D bitmap cache.
  See `examples/image_viewer` and `docs/tutorials/image-viewer.md`.
- Background work and notification-area utility: `examples/wakeup` and
  `examples/hot_corners`.
- Dialogs, clipboard, file drop, placement: `examples/desktop_integration`.
- DPI and appearance: `examples/dpi` and `examples/appearance`.
- Native fallback: `GetHwnd`, `WindowMessage`, and ordinary Win32 contracts.

## Never generate

Do not use local control wrappers in BuildUI, touch controls from workers, invent
signals or a data-context system, include `src/detail`, throw through callbacks,
mix pixels with DIP layout, claim raw HWND ownership without a documented
transfer, or consume the moving `main` branch in a reproducible project.

## Verification

Compile the smallest template or `tools/api-probe` before adding features. Use
only symbols found in public headers or `docs/agent-reference.md`. See
`docs/recipes` for task flows and `docs/reference-apps` for composed programs.
OPTIONAL THIRD-PARTY AND RENDERING INTEGRATIONS

Generic HWND: mwtl/native_host.h; NativeHost owns a container and borrows one
same-thread direct-child HWND. Attach enables resize, focus, and synchronous
notification forwarding. Detach does not destroy or reparent.

WebView2: configure MWTL_BUILD_WEBVIEW2=ON; link mwtl::webview2; include
mwtl/webview2.h. SDK 1.0.4129.50 is hash-pinned. Run in an STA. Query Runtime
availability, wait for WebView2HostState::ready, keep callbacks on the owner
thread, use Restart after posting out of a process-failure callback, and Close
before owner teardown. GetController/GetWebView are borrowed. Offline tests use
NavigateToString. Reference: examples/browser and docs/tutorials/browser.md.

Scintilla: configure MWTL_BUILD_SCINTILLA=ON; link mwtl::scintilla; call
mwtl_deploy_scintilla(target); include mwtl/scintilla.h. Scintilla 5.6.5 is
hash-pinned. LoadAdjacent before Create. Public strings are strict UTF-16/UTF-8;
positions are UTF-8 byte offsets. Notifications and HWND calls stay on the UI
thread. Reference: examples/code_editor and docs/tutorials/code-editor.md.

Direct2D uses mwtl::d2d, Direct3D uses mwtl::d3d, and WIC imaging uses
mwtl::imaging. These optional targets never belong on core mwtl::mwtl.

PRINTING, OLE, AND SHELL

Printing: request COMPONENTS printing and link mwtl::printing. Keep document
content and PrintPage pagination authoritative outside printer/preview state.
PrintJob owns native transactions and aborts incomplete work; render HDCs are
borrowed. Preview works without a printer.

OLE: request COMPONENTS ole, link mwtl::ole, and use ComApartment::ole_sta.
Payloads are copied, bounded, and contain no application pointers. STGMEDIUM
ownership follows COM transfer rules. Drop callbacks are reentrant UI-thread
calls; revoke registrations before HWND teardown.

Shell: request COMPONENTS shell and link mwtl::shell. VersionedSettingsStore
writes its schema marker last. File associations are explicit per-user,
owner-marked, and reversible. Jump Lists require an STA and stable IDs. Taskbar
objects stay on their creating UI thread and are recreated after TaskbarCreated.
Handle unavailable, rejected, access, and COM failures. Reference:
examples/printing, examples/ole_drag_drop, examples/shell_integration, and
docs/tutorials/printing-ole-shell.md.

DOCKING WORKSPACES

Start at examples/docking_workspace, docs/tutorials/docking-workspace.md, and
docs/recipes/docking-workspace.md. DockLayoutModel owns pointer-free metadata;
the application owns panel content, documents, commands, and HWNDs. IDs for
panels, groups, nodes, and floating hosts are stable, nonzero application IDs,
never HWNDs or pointers. All native work remains on the creating UI thread.

Mutations use propose -> native prepare/adopt -> logical commit -> native
commit. Roll back adoption if commit fails. DockDragSession separates hit test,
proposal, nonactivating preview, and commit; Escape, capture loss, destruction,
stale state, rejected adoption, and exceptions cancel without losing the source
layout. Expose the same targets through DockKeyboardSession. Floating windows
own auxiliary top-level HWNDs and borrow panel hosts; they do not post process
quit. Save only bounded, versioned, pointer-free committed snapshots in DIPs,
recover them against current monitors, and fall back to a deterministic layout.

OPTIONAL RIBBON, LEGACY MDI, GRAPHICS, TASKBAR, AND HELP

Ribbon: request COMPONENTS ribbon and link mwtl::ribbon. Generate UICC resources
into the executable. RibbonCommandModel stores stable pointer-free IDs, modes,
contexts, and copied recent metadata; RibbonFrameworkHost borrows the frame and
CommandSet and owns COM callbacks on one STA UI thread. Treat GetFramework as
borrowed, support unavailable fallback, and destroy before COM shutdown. Start
at examples/ribbon_workspace and docs/tutorials/ribbon.md.

Legacy MDI: request COMPONENTS mdi and link mwtl::mdi. Prefer the modern
DocumentWorkspaceModel for new products. MdiWorkspaceModel owns metadata only;
the application owns documents and views. Route stable MdiChildId values without
a global current pointer, collect every dirty decision before any close, and
destroy MdiHost on its creating UI thread. Start at examples/mdi_workspace and
docs/tutorials/mdi.md.

EMF/GDI+: request COMPONENTS graphics and link mwtl::graphics. EnhancedMetafile
owns HENHMETAFILE and is move-only. Recording HDC and Gdiplus::Graphics values
are callback-scoped. EMF frame units are 0.01 mm, playback rectangles are
pixels, PNG dimensions/pixels are bounded, and export uses sibling replacement.
Start at examples/graphics_interop and docs/tutorials/graphics-help.md.

Taskbar/Help: request COMPONENTS shell and link mwtl::shell. Reapply progress,
overlay, thumbnail buttons, and registered/active tabs after TaskbarCreated.
Stable IDs are application values; icons and HWNDs are borrowed. HelpRequest
accepts absolute local CHM/HTML or HTTPS only and never constructs a shell
command. Use LaunchHelpWithBackend for offline tests. Start at
examples/shell_integration and docs/tutorials/graphics-help.md.
